dialogs.about: 호텔 방에서 할아버지와 저녁 식당을 고르며 예약을 이야기해요

lines.en: Let's reserve a table for dinner tonight.
Good idea. Did you make a booking already?
No. I called them this morning but nobody answered.
lines.ko: 아니요. 오늘 아침에 전화했는데 아무도 받지 않았어요.

lines.en: Which restaurant do you recommend?
The small one near the plaza. Their specialty is fish.
lines.ko: 광장 가까이 있는 작은 집이요. 특선 요리가 생선이에요.

lines.en: Nice. Is there quiet seating by the window?
Yes. I will ask for a window table.
Remember my allergy. I can't eat nuts.
lines.ko: 내 알레르기를 기억해 줘요. 나는 견과류를 못 먹어요.

lines.en: I remember. I will tell the waitress about nuts.
Then let's order an appetizer and split it. Thank you.
lines.ko: 그러면 전채를 하나 시켜서 나눠 먹어요. 고마워요.

dialogs.about: 식당에 들어가 여종업원에게 예약을 확인하고 음식을 물어봐요

lines.en: Hello. We have a booking for two people.
Hello. Did you reserve by phone?
Yes, my daughter reserved it this morning.
lines.ko: 네, 오늘 아침에 제 딸이 예약했어요.

lines.en: I found it. Is this seating okay for you?
Yes, thank you. What do you recommend today?
Our specialty is fish soup. The appetizer is free.
lines.ko: 저희 특선 요리는 생선국이에요. 전채는 무료예요.

lines.en: I have a nut allergy. Is the soup safe?
lines.ko: 저는 견과류 알레르기가 있어요. 그 국은 괜찮아요?

lines.en: It is safe. We also have a vegetarian dish.
Good. We will split one bowl of soup.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 국 한 그릇을 나눠 먹을게요.

lines.en: Of course. I will bring water in a minute.
